bubble-football-43.summary: Bounce, crash and laugh your way through Krakow in giant inflatable bubbles.
bubble-football-43.description: Add a ridiculous twist to the world most popular game. Bubble Football is built for groups who want an active, easy-to-book experience with plenty of chaos and no football skills required.
highlights: Ideal for stag groups, birthdays and team events
